notes.title: Dreamgate Update #12 - New cards, Heroes and more
notes.content:
Hi! There has been no news from us for a long time ... and our team would like to apologize for that.
The past year was quite difficult for ours due to the COVID epidemic.
This situation changed our plans and slowed down the game development process a lot.

But we continue to add features to our game and are getting closer to the release of our game.
In this patch, we added: 50 Cunning cards, 4 new heroes and fixed some bugs

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #10 - Balance Changes
notes.content:
Hi!
We continue to improve our game. Based on the collected statistics and your feedback, we made a rebalance for cards and passive skills

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Drop chance for gold cards is slightly increased. 
[*]Some encounters have been slightly changed.
[*]Now you get More gold after defeating Doomlord.
[/list]


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Skills [/h2]
[list]
[*]Battle Rage buff: Discard a card: if you discard a Spell, deal 1 damage to ALL enemies [b]3 times[/b] -> Discard a card: if you discard a Spell, deal 1 damage to ALL enemies [b]4 times[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Passive Skills[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fighter buff: damage increased from 7 to 9.
[*]Demonic Armor buff: Gain [b]+7[/b] Max HP -> Gain [b]+9[/b] Max HP.
Dark Power buff: Damage from all your cards is increased by [b]1[/b] -> Damage from all your cards is increased by [b]2[/b].
[*]Iron Will buff: If your deck contains [b]60+ card[/b]s, draw an additional card per turn -> If your deck contains [b]50+ cards[/b], draw an additional card per turn.
[*]Gladiator changed: Weapon cards deal 1 more damage.
[*]Mage changed: Spell cards deal 1 more damage.
[*]Mark of the Void buff: Gain +8 Max HP. [b]Exile 5[/b] random cards. -> Gain +8 Max HP. [b]Exile 3[/b] random cards.
[/list]
[h2]Weapon[/h2]
[list]
[*]Spiked Club buff: damage increased from 1 -4 to 1-5.
[*]Increased damage for all upgraded weapons.
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bomb buff: damage increased from 1 to 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #9 - New levels for Hard Mode and Balance Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We continue to work on the game and in this patch we made some balance changes and added 8 new levels for the “Hard mode”.
We also started working on a "Cunning skills" - there will be 40 new cards and several new heroes who will use these cards

[h2]Gameplay[/h2][list]
[*]8 new levels for Hard Mode, for those who want more challenge.
[*]The amount of experience required to receive rewards has been reduced.[/list]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2][list]
[*]Furious Charge buffed: Lose -3 HP -> Lose -2 HP.
[*]B.F. Axe changed: Deal 3 damage. If you have 40 or more cards in your deck deal 16 damage instead -> Deal 4 damage. If you have 50 or more cards in your deck deal 18 damage instead.
[*]Doomlord slightly changed 
[*]Savage (passive skill) buffed: Gain +10 Max HP -> Gain +15 Max HP.
[*]Hunter (passive skill) buffed: Lose -5 Max HP -> Lose -4 Max HP.
[*]Perseverance (passive skill) nerfed: Lose -3 Max HP  -> Lose -7 Max HP. [i]This passive skill for Warlock was too strong especially compared to Hunter[/i]
[*]Slayer (passive skill) buffed: Deal +2 damage to bosses -> Deal +3 damage to bosses.
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2][list][*]Added Chinese (Simplified)[/list]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #8 - New "Game Progress System", Hero and Cards
notes.content:
Hi all!
It's time for a new big patch! In this patch we add to the game - New game progression system, new hero and 15+ new cards

[h2]New systems[/h2][list][*]Game progression system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766264/ed97f5a5b1668e93108ca01a349ea46611cb8d65.png[/img]
[*]Game statistics[/list]

[h2]New Hero[/h2][list][*]Bloodmage[/list]

[h2]New Cards (Items)[/h2][list][*]Demon's Horn - Exile a card from your draw pile.
[*]Thief's Hood - Reserve. Charge 1. Escape from a non-boss encounter. Receive no loot.
[*]Cultist Wand - Limited. Draw 3 cards. Add a Curse on top of the draw pile.
[*]Belt- Limited. Draw 2 random cards from discard pile. If you have 30 or more cards in your discard pile, draw 3 random cards from discard pile instead.
[*]Dynamite- Limited. Charge 1. Deal 12 damage.
[*]Cursed Locket - Unplayable. Gold 200. At the start of your turn discard a non-Curse card.
[*]The Silent Killer - Reserve. Destroy a non-Boss enemy. You can use this card only if one enemy in the encounter.[/list]

[h2]New Cards (Bloodmage)[/h2][list][*]Fireworks - Deal 2 damage. If you have 10 or more Fire cards in your deck deal 8 damage instead.
[*]Magic Bomb - Energy 1. Deal 3 damage for each Magic Bomb in your deck.
[*]Fire Club - Energy 1. Fire. Deal 1 damage 5 times.
[*]Wrath - Energy 3. Deal 17 damage. If you have 25 or less cards in your deck deal 6 damage to all enemies instead.
[*]Rebirth - Reduce your maximum HP by 2. Restore to full HP.
[*]Spirit of Fire - Energy 2. Draw 4 random Fire cards from your draw pile.
[*]Vengeance - Deal X damage, where X is the number of missing HP. Lose -1 HP.
[*]Fire Nova - Energy 4. Fire. Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
[*]Ash Ritual - Exile Fire card from your hand and restore 5 HP.
[*]Renegade - Charge 1. Exile all Fire cards from your deck. Increase your max HP by 8.
[/list]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #7 - Balance Changes and New Passive Skills
notes.content:
Hi all,

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*]Mighty Strike buffed: bonus damage increased from 4 ->5
[*]Net buffed: Limited. Reduce the attack of all enemies by 1. -> Limited. Reduce the attack of all enemies by 1. Draw a card.

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2][list][*]Fixed bug with a Phantom Sentinel
[*] Fixed visual bug with cards backlit 
[*]Fixed Russian localization[/list]

It's time for a big patch! In this patch we add to the game - 3 new heroes and more than 40 new cards.

- Elementalist (Arcane)
- Battle Mage (Arcane and War)
- Voidbringer (Arcane and Dark)

[*][u]Elemental Blow[/u] - Deal 1 damage. Upgrade all Elemental Blow cards in your deck.

[*][u]Magic Trick[/u] - Deal 4 damage.

[*][u]Energy Leech[/u] - Deal 3 damage, gain 1 Energy and draw a card. You can use this card only on stunned enemies.
[*][u]Shock[/u] - Lightning. Reserve. Unplayable. At the end of your turn deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
[*][u]Enchanted Weapon[/u] - Fire. Energy 1. This turn, your next Weapon deals +7 damage.
[*][u]Fire Breat[/u]h - Fire. Reserve. Energy 3. Deal 4 damage to all enemies.
[*][u]Wisdom of the Elements[/u] - Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn, draw an additional card and discard a card from hand.
[*][u]Meteor[/u] - Fire. Energy 4. Deal 36 damage.
[*][u]Arcane Power[/u] - Gain 1 Energy.
[*][u]Arcane Intellect[/u] - Energy 2. Draw 3 cards.
[*][u]Frost Arrow[/u] - Ice. Energy 1. Stun a non-Boss enemy and deal 1 damage to adjacent ones. Draw a random Ice card from your draw pile.
[*][u]Frost Breath[/u] - Ice. Energy 3. Stun all non-Boss enemies.
[*][u]Stone Armour[/u] - Earth. Energy 2. Gain a Shield.
[*][u]Elemental Arrows[/u] - Fire. Lightning. Ice. Earth. Energy 1. Deal 1 damage 3 times.
[*][u]Ice and Lightning[/u] - Ice. Deal 2 damage. If you have a Lightning card in your hand deal 5 damage instead.
[*][u]Manastorm[/u] - Limited. Gain 3 Energy. Lose -1 HP.
[*][u]Inner Power[/u] - Draw a card. If you have 6 or more energy, draw 4 cards instead and you cannot draw additional cards this turn.
[*][u]Elemental Equilibrium[/u] - Limited. Energy 1. Draw a random Fire, Earth, Ice and Lightning card from your  draw pile.
[*][u]Hailstorm[/u] - Ice. Energy 2. Deal 2 damage 7 times to random enemies.
[*][u]Amplification[/u] - Fumble 1. This turn, your next Spell deals triple damage.
[*][u]Eruption[/u] - Earth. Energy 1. Deal 1 damage to all enemies. If you have a Fire card in your hand deal 3 damage instead.
[*][u]Magical Gifts[/u] - Energy 3. Charge 1. Choose a Passive card.
[*][u]Spellslinger[/u] - Deal 10 damage. You can use this card only if you have a Wand in your deck
[*][u]Wind Strike[/u] - Deal 6 damage. Put a card from your hand on top of the draw pile.
[*][u]Spark[/u] - Lightning. Energy 1. Deal 3 damage. If you have 10 or more cards in your hand deal 10 
damage instead.
[*][u]Chain Lightning[/u] - Lightning. Energy 1. Deal 2 damage. Then deal 3 damage to a random enemy, then deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
[*][u]Thirst of Knowledge[/u] - Energy 1. Charge 1. Delve 3 Arcane common cards. Lose -1 Max HP. 
[*][u]Twister[/u] - Energy 1. If you have 4 or more cards with Reserve in your hand, deal 6 damage to all 
enemies.
[*][u]Ice Cage[/u] - Ice. Energy 2. Stun an enemy.
[*][u]Rockfall[/u] - Earth. Energy 2. Deal 12 damage. If you have another Earth card in your hand deal 24 damage instead.
[*][u]Path of Darkness[/u] - Energy 2. Charge 1. Delve 3 Dark rare cards.
[*][u]Overload[/u] - Reserve. Unplayable. All your Spell deals double damage. Play no more than 3 cards per turn.
[*][u]Mirror Image[/u]- Charge 1. Choose a non-Legendary card from your hand and add 2 copies of it to the draw pile.
[*][u]Burning Aura[/u] - Fire. Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn deal 1 damage to all enemies.
[*][u]Dragon Wisdom[/u] - Limited. Draw 3 random Spells from your draw pile. Gain 1 Energy.
[*][u]Firestorm[/u] - Fire. Energy 3. Deal 6 damage 3 times to random enemies. If you have an Earth card in your hand, gain 3 Energy.
[*][u]Clarity[/u] - Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn gain 1 Energy.
[*][u]Ice Block[/u] - Ice. Reserve. Unplayable. At the end of your turn gain a Shield. Play no more than 3 cards per turn.
[*][u]Shatter[/u] - Ice. Energy 2. Destroy a non-Boss enemy. If a target is stunned deal 3 damage to all 
enemies.
[*][u]Inspiration[/u] - Limited. Draw 6 cards. Discard all Spell cards from your hand.
[*][u]Earthquake[/u] - Earth. Energy 3. Stun all enemies with 2 or less attack. Deal 3 damage to all enemies 
with 3 or more attack.
[/list]

[b]New Cards (Item):[/b]
- Arcane Wand - Deal 3 damage. If you have 25 or less cards in your deck deal 6 damage instead.

[b]Some UI Improvements[/b]

[b]Various bugs fixed[/b]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #5 - New Library and Treasure Chest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
It's time for the next patch, which improves some aspects of our game.
A little spoilers: at the moment we are working on a large patch that will add 40 new cards (Arcane) and 3 new heroes to the game...stay tuned

[*]Fixed bug with Talisman and Greed.

[*]Talisman ability now "draw 2 random spells" instead of 2 random cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #3 - New game mode, Russian localization and more
notes.content:
Hi!
It's time for the next patch, in which we added:
[h3]New Features[/h3]Anomalies mode - new game mode. In this mode you will need to select 1 anomaly from 3 and its effect will continue throughout the game. Therefore, it will be possible to select up to 3 different anomalies.
In addition to this, anomalies may appear in some battles and they will slightly change the game rules.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766264/69252c4f4d03773c5d7e06d137086eb2acd47c10.png[/img]

[h3]New Content[/h3][list][*]Bow (weapon) - Limited. Deal 3 damage. Draw a card.
[*]Champion 4/8 - Shield. Revenge: All enemies gain +1 Attack and Health.
Special loot from Champion:[list][*]The Executioner - Destroy a non-Boss enemy with 4 or less Attack.
[*]Tower Shield - If there are 3 or more enemies get a Shield.[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*]Gargoyle: Tough removed, attack increased from 5 -> 6.
[*]Spiked Club buff: max damage increased by 1.
[*]Anger now Skill instead Spell.
[*]Vengeance now Spell insted Skill.
[*]Vengeance renamed to Blood Magic.
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3][list][*]Added Russian localization
[*]Fixed some English text
[/list]

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
it's time for the first big update for our game.

[h2]New Features[/h2][list][*]Game Map - now you will see all the encounters that will be on the level and you can plan your adventure from start to finish[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2][list][*]Bury (Dark Common) - Deal 2 damage. Discard 4 cards from top of the draw pile.
[*]The Stars Are Right (Dark Rare) - Limited. Deal 1-11 damage. If you have 3+ copies of this card in your deck, deal 14 damage to all enemies instead.
[*]Magic Book (Item) - Charge 1. Choose a Spell card in your hand and gain a copy of it to your hand.
[*]Animated Armor- New boss for level 3.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*]Unbreakable buff: now exile all Wounds, Curses and Poisons.
[*]Duel buff: Rage: Draw a card -> Draw 2 cards.
[*]Seismic Strike buff:For every 10 cards in the deck, deal 1 damage -> For every 10 cards in the deck, deal 2 damage.
[*]Furious Charge buff: damage increased from 12 -> 14
[*]Bloodlust rarity changed from Rare -> Legendary
[*]Seismic Strike rarity changed from Legendary -> Rare
[*]Soul Fire rarity changed from Common -> Rare
[*]Dark Ritual rarity changed from Rare -> Legendary
[*]Hellfire nerf: damage reduced from 4 -> 3
[*]Removed 1 Devourer from hard encounter on level 2.
[*]Doomlord difficulty slightly increased
[*]Level 3 bosses difficulty slightly increased
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2][list][*]Improved localization for English text. Thanks to KingJoshington for helping with the proofreading of the English text.
[*]Some keywords have been changed:[list][*]Fatigue X-> Fumble X
[*]Regeneration -> Regen
[*]Endurance ->Tough
[*]Last Breath -> Revenge
[*]Usage X-> Charge X
[*]Choose One - > Choose
[*]Retrace - > Echo
[*]Rampage -> Rage
[/list]
[/list][h2]Bug fix[/h2][list][*]Fixed bug with character screen selection
[*]Fixed bug with passive skill King and Blacksmith
[*]Fixed bug with passive skill Berserk
[*]Berserk and Flex now work properly
[/list]

We also want to thank all those of you who actively helped us (reported bugs and made suggestions for improving the game)
Dreamgate Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE]https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE[/url] - join to our community.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hi!
This is the first “Dev Diary” and we are plan to release it every 2 weeks to inform you about the development of the game and our plans.
This week, we released a patch that fixed a large number of bugs in our game + we released several “hot fixes”. At the same time, we continue to work on the quality of our game. I also want to thank all the players who reported bugs (our Discord: https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE - join to our community).
As for the changes and improvements that we are currently working on and which you can already see in the next patch (at the end of next week):
